name: Tooltip
usage: Explaining why something is disabled, the meaning of icons or abbreviations, the full text of truncated labels

props.name: title
props.description: Text of the tooltip. Without it, no tooltip is shown.

props.name: placement
props.description: Position of the tooltip relative to the trigger.

props.name: mouseEnterDelay
props.description: Delay before the tooltip appears on hover, in seconds.

props.name: trigger
props.description:
What shows the tooltip: `hover`, `focus` (any focus, including from a click) or `click`. Keyboard focus shows
a hover tooltip as well.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger: one element that accepts events and a ref.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Appears after hovering for 500 ms, so it does not flash while the pointer passes over.

examples.name: DisabledReason
examples.title: Explaining a disabled state
examples.description: A disabled button does not receive mouse events, so a `span` around it receives the hover.
